issues.body: This diff publicly exposes `store::object_store` and re-exports `ObjectStoreBlobStore`, including its constructors and prefix semantics. AGENTS.md's maintenance rule requires every new or changed public API to update the matching `skills/<surface>/SKILL.md` (and crate README) in the same change. No such file appears in this diff, so users of the Solid/LWS surface have no maintained instructions for constructing the real object-store backend, and the PR is incomplete by the repository's explicit public-API contract.
issues.fix_hint: Update the Solid/LWS usage skill (`skills/solid-lws-server/SKILL.md`, moving longer material to its references if needed) and the crate README, if present/applicable, with a concise native-only `ObjectStoreBlobStore` construction example, prefix behavior, and the versionless reconciliation/CAS limitation. Include those documentation files in this PR.
issues.title: New public BlobStore adapter is missing the required surface documentation update

verdict.summary: The adapter implementation and its end-to-end reconciliation test are internally coherent, but the PR adds and re-exports a new public native API without updating the required usage skill. Under this repository's maintenance rule, that makes the public-surface change incomplete and blocks approval until its consumer documentation is updated in the same PR.
